light_description: Dual-channel overdrive platform combining two complementary drive voices for stacking, dynamic low-to-medium gain and thicker amp-pushing tones.
Fuzz pedal with a saturated, harmonically rich response designed for expressive vintage-style fuzz textures.
Compact fuzz with a responsive gain range and thick sustained character, emphasizing touch and guitar-volume interaction.
Silicon Fuzz Phrase variant with a tighter, more immediate response and saturated fuzz character.
Dual-voice octave fuzz with selectable clipping options and pronounced upper-harmonic textures.
NOS-transistor Octaurus variant offering dual octave-fuzz voices with a more vintage-oriented transistor character.
RAT-style distortion covering lower-gain grit through saturated hard-clipping distortion.
Limited-edition Rattler using an LM308 and point-to-point construction, retaining the core RAT-style distortion character.
Big Muff-style fuzz and distortion with thick sustain and a broad saturated response.
Bass-oriented Muff-style fuzz and distortion designed to retain substantial low-end authority under high gain.
Tube Screamer-style overdrive with a selectable high-gain stage for familiar mid-focused drive through thicker gain.
Overdrive with dry/wet blending and a high-gain stage, balancing direct signal clarity with saturated drive.
Dual overdrive platform using complementary drive sections for stacking and expanded gain combinations.
Compact preamp and overdrive designed for low-to-medium gain coloration and amplifier pushing.
Compact low-to-medium gain overdrive with an amp-like breakup character and simple tonal control.
Candidate excluded from inventory because it is a delay rather than a dirt product; retained only as a scope reminder.
Compact booster designed to raise signal level while adding harmonic drive into an amplifier or pedal chain.
Germanium-voiced Muff-style fuzz built for thick sustain and saturated harmonic texture.
Compact fuzz with a smooth, saturated character and thick sustain.
Colorful compact fuzz pedal offering thick, compressed saturation and expressive harmonic texture.
Scope-bound candidate excluded because the model is not a dedicated dirt pedal.
Compact overdrive providing warm, responsive breakup and amp-pushing gain.
Excluded from Phase One dirt inventory because the primary effect is compression rather than overdrive, distortion or fuzz.
Compact overdrive designed for crunchy amplifier-style breakup and thicker saturated drive.
Compact distortion voiced for saturated, articulate gain with a broad response.
Two-stage gain pedal spanning boost and overdrive through more saturated distortion, with independent gain shaping and three-band EQ.
Highly adjustable fuzz capable of open overdrive, thick saturation and sputtering or gated high-gain textures.
Fuzz with extensive control over gain, tone and compression, covering thick sustaining fuzz through more broken-up textures.
Fuzz pedal with interactive filtering and an additional overdrive-style effects-loop section for unusual saturated and synth-like textures.
Distortion combined with delay and chorus-style modulation, allowing saturated gain to be shaped into larger layered textures.
High-headroom boost designed to add level and harmonic push, with enough gain to move an amplifier into light breakup.
Triple-path distortion system that creates parallel saturated voices and recombines them for thick, harmonically complex dirt textures.
